items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: When Fat's got married, he and I were buddies like that. ... We were old time buddies. His mother partly raised me.

ctx.x: I don't guess Fat's will ever get his sight back. It's tough. Yeah.
Next time he comes in town, you ought to interview Fat's. Yeah, we've never interviewed him.
We've talked a lot. He knows a lot. Oh, yeah, yeah.
